conventions.notes: Task prompts name only an item ID. Items live in the ops queue: an opaque store (.ops/queue.pack) that only bin/fetch-ticket reads. The README mentions only the ops queue.
The lookup output lists the files to change under 'Files:' (the `files` field with --json). Registry items list the CSV and the module that reads it, never the generated file.

tests/__init__.py aborts unless PORTSIDE_ENV=test, which only `make check` sets. Plain unittest fails at once; `PORTSIDE_ENV=test python3 -m unittest` would work (an environment fix). The working command is declared in .ci/pipeline.yml.
conventions.signature: RuntimeError: PORTSIDE_ENV is not set, run the suite with 'make check'

conventions.notes: Lookups read portside/generated/registry.py, generated from registry/*.csv. Editing a CSV requires make gen; make check and the hidden checks fail on stale output.
conventions.signature: error: portside/generated/registry.py is out of date with registry/*.csv, run 'make gen'

decoys.notes: A plausible target nothing depends on. Running it changes nothing.
Looks like a regeneration step but generates nothing tracked; it is never required after any edit.
A lint step that always passes; it is not the test suite and not a dead end.

description: The hidden conventions of the portside-dispatch sandbox (evals/gen, python-make, seed 13): what a learner should find. Decoys are planted commands no route may direct.
